subject.title: fix: reconcile timed-out gateway message actions

question: Is same-process-only reconciliation sufficient for timed-out gateway message actions, despite restart and long-tail timeout gaps?
rationale: The implementation correctly uses the current idempotency contract, but tests cannot decide whether its process lifetime and bounded wait provide an acceptable message-delivery guarantee.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Merge after a delayed real-channel run proves exactly one visible delivery, and track restart-durable reconciliation separately.

options.title: Require durable reconciliation
options.body: Pause until same-key outcomes survive gateway restart and remain authoritative through the intended delivery window.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Merge after a delayed real-channel run proves exactly one visible delivery, and track restart-durable reconciliation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway client and message-action history makes this the strongest available owner for the delivery guarantee decision.
